Order 
Dated this the 7th day of November, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash Annexure A1 FIR, Annexure A2 Final Report and all further proceedings in L.P.No.148/2005 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Chalakkudy, arose out of Crime No.149/2003 of Koratty Police Station, Thrissur.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner herein is the second accused in the above crime.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned counsel appearing for the de facto complainant and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3.

In this matter, offences punishable under Sections 143, 147, 354, 506(ii), 498A and 376 r/w 149 of the Indian Penal Code (hereinafter referred to as 'IPC' for short) are alleged to have been committed by the accused.

It is pointed out by the learned counsel for the petitioner that even though offence under Section 376 of IPC also is involved, the victim is none other than the wife of the second accused, the petitioner herein, and the case against all other accused in this matter has been quashed by this Court as per common order dated 20.02.2006 in Crl.M.C.Nos.4155, 4156, 4167 & 4185 of 2005.
A copy of the said order has been placed for the perusal of this Court.
5. The learned Public Prosecutor also submitted that the matter has been settled between the parties and statement of the de facto complainant to that effect has been recorded.

6. Having noticed the fact that the crux of the dispute is in between the husband and wife and the wife filed affidavit stating that she has no grievance in this matter, and further this Court already quashed the case against the other accused much earlier, as evident from the copy of order placed by the learned counsel for the petitioner, 2024:KER:82999 CRL.MC NO. 4513 OF 2023 there is no reason to disallow the prayer for quashment.
Therefore, in the interest of justice, I am inclined to allow this petition.
